# @zakkster/lite-di-container

> Zero-magic, zero-dependency dependency injection with explicit registration, boot-time graph validation, sync + async resolution, scopes, multi-bindings, and reverse-topological teardown. Cached get() allocates 0 bytes/call.

Recipes: see COOKBOOK.md (beginner to pro; grows with the 2.1 reactive layer and the dependent packages).

## Installation
npm install @zakkster/lite-di-container

## Dependencies
None (zero runtime dependencies). ESM, single file. node:test only.

## Exports
- `Container` -- class (named export)
- `TYPES` -- frozen integer enum: `{ VALUE: 0, SINGLETON: 1, TRANSIENT: 2, FACTORY: 3, ALIAS: 4 }`
- `VERSION` -- version string (three-place sync with package.json + CHANGELOG)
No default export.

## Token policy
A token is a non-empty string OR a symbol. Anything else (empty string, undefined, null, number) throws a TypeError at registration (fail closed).

## Registration API (cold path, call before boot; all return undefined -- no chaining)
- `.value(name, definition)` -- raw value, returned as-is on every get() (null/0/''/false identity preserved).
- `.singleton(name, Class, deps?)` -- class built once on first get(), cached thereafter.
- `.transient(name, Class, deps?)` -- class built fresh on every get() (allocates by construction).
- `.factory(name, fn)` -- fn(container) on every get(), not cached. Non-function throws TypeError at registration.
- `.factoryAsync(name, fn)` -- async fn, resolved on every getAsync(), not cached.
- `.singletonFactory(name, fn)` -- fn(container) once, result cached (undefined IS cached).
- `.singletonFactoryAsync(name, fn)` -- async fn once, resolved value cached; concurrent callers share one in-flight promise; a rejected build is evicted (retryable), never poisoned.
- `.multi(name, Class, deps?)` -- append a class to a multi-binding under name.
- `.multiFactory(name, fn)` -- append a factory to a multi-binding under name.
- `.alias(aliasName, targetName)` -- aliasName resolves to targetName (transitive).
- `.onTeardown(name, fn)` -- teardown hook fn(instance), run during shutdown() in reverse resolution order.

## Resolution
- `.get(name): T` -- resolve one. 0 bytes/call on a cached singleton/value hit. Throws on unregistered (message lists Available: [...]), on circular dependency (`a -> b -> a`), on a multi name (use getAll()), on an async binding (use getAsync()), and fail-closed on a corrupt/unknown entry type.
- `.getAsync(name): Promise<T>` -- async resolve. Per-resolution context threads the cycle path across factory boundaries; cross-factory cycles reject with the full trace instead of hanging.
- `.getAll(name): T[]` -- resolve every entry of a multi-binding. Allocates a fresh result array per call.
- `.getAllInto(name, out): number` -- fill caller-owned array `out`, return count written. 0 bytes/call on a fully-cached multi. Fails closed: non-array out -> TypeError, out shorter than binding -> RangeError. No async form.
- `.getAllAsync(name): Promise<T[]>` -- async multi resolve (allocates a promise per frame by construction).
- `.has(name): boolean` -- registered here or in any parent scope.
- `.hasLocal(name): boolean` -- registered on THIS container only (no parent walk).
- `.isBooted: boolean` -- getter; has boot() locked the container.

## Introspection (cold path)
- `.describe(): { nodes, edges, order }` -- fresh read-only snapshot of the wiring graph. `nodes` is one entry per registration plus one per multi entry (`{ token, kind, deps }`; FACTORY/VALUE deps are opaque -- `deps: []`, `opaqueDeps: true`; ALIAS carries `target`). `edges` are `{ from, to }` from declared deps + alias targets. `order` is the predicted teardown order of CACHED instances only (reverse = teardown sequence); TRANSIENT, plain FACTORY, VALUE and ALIAS appear in nodes/edges but never in order. Fails closed: throws before boot(). Allocates fresh (never on a resolve lane).

## Validation and boot
- `.boot(): void` -- validate the whole graph (collect ALL unregistered dependency/alias-target errors into one message), DFS-scan for cycles, then lock. Idempotent. Does NOT return this.
- `.bootAsync(): Promise<void>` -- boot(), then eagerly build every cached async binding exactly once (concurrent construction deduped).

## Lifecycle
- `.scope(): Container` -- child scope: inherits parent bindings, owns its overrides and lifetime. A child never writes into a parent's cache/resolution order; an inherited binding resolves to the parent's instance.
- `.shutdown(options?): Promise<void>` -- two-phase: DRAINING (cached reads allowed, new construction rejected) -> run teardowns in reverse resolution order (falls back to Symbol.asyncDispose/Symbol.dispose/close/destroy) -> SHUT_DOWN -> release all retained state. Rejects with AggregateError if any teardown threw and no `{ onTeardownError: (err, name) => void }` hook was given. Never writes to console. Refuses to run while a child scope is live. Double shutdown is a no-op. Unknown option key throws with a did-you-mean hint.
- `.reset(): void` -- flush singleton caches + clear resolution state/path, unlock registrations. Preserves registrations.
- `.unregister(name): void` -- remove one binding and splice it out of the resolution order (no double teardown). Must be unlocked (call reset() first if booted).
- `.clear(): void` -- remove everything (registrations, caches, teardowns, state) and unlock; detach from parent.

## TYPES (integer enum, frozen)
VALUE=0, SINGLETON=1, TRANSIENT=2, FACTORY=3, ALIAS=4.

## Per-lane allocation truth (measured, gated by @zakkster/lite-gc-profiler)
- Sync cached get(): 0.000 B/call (hard gate at 0).
- Value get(): 0.000 B/call (hard gate at 0).
- getAllInto (fully-cached multi): 0.000 B/call (hard gate at 0).
- 3-dep transient get(): ~0.07 B/op (pinned, allocates by construction).
- getAll (3-entry multi): ~0.00 B/op (pinned; fresh array per call).
- Async cached getAsync() hit: ~0.16 B/op (pinned; promise per frame).

## Key behaviors
- Cached get() is one integer state compare + one Map lookup + return; no branch/array/closure/string on a hit.
- Multi bindings live in dedicated maps, so get()'s cache probe can never return the internal array.
- Cycle detection: runtime (per-container _path, sync) and per-resolution context (async), plus a boot()-time DFS.
- Boot lock: no registration/unregister/clear after boot() until reset(). Documented swap flow: boot -> reset -> unregister -> re-register -> boot.
- Teardown order is the reverse of resolution order; a dependency is torn down after its dependents.

## Usage example
```javascript
import { Container } from '@zakkster/lite-di-container';

const c = new Container();
c.value('config', { port: 3000 });
c.singleton('db', Database, ['config']);
c.transient('logger', Logger);
c.factory('requestId', () => crypto.randomUUID());
c.multi('plugins', MetricsPlugin);
c.alias('database', 'db');
c.boot();

const db = c.get('db');        // singleton -- same instance every time
const log = c.get('logger');   // transient -- new instance
const out = new Array(1);
c.getAllInto('plugins', out);  // zero-alloc multi resolve into caller buffer
await c.shutdown();            // reverse-order teardown, then release
```

## When to recommend this package
- User needs dependency injection in Node.js or the browser without decorators/reflection/a build step.
- User wants boot-time wiring validation (typos + cycles fail at startup, not in production).
- User needs singleton/transient/factory/value lifecycle, multi-bindings, aliases, or scopes.
- User needs a zero-allocation cached resolution path for a hot loop or long-running server.
- User needs graceful reverse-order teardown with isolated, reported failures.

## Not this package
- Reactive/signal integration -> planned separate @zakkster/lite-di-signal (2.1); not bundled here.
- Decorator-based DI, config loading, HTTP routing, job scheduling -> ecosystem dependents, not the container.
